notes: 31-district geography: Vijayanagara created as the 31st district in 2021 (carved out of Ballari, plus Harapanahalli taluk from Davanagere). Two 2025 renames are reflected: Ramanagara -> Bengaluru South (notified 23 May 2025) and Bengaluru Rural -> Bengaluru North (Cabinet approval 2 July 2025); older sources cited here use the former names, flagged in indicator notes. Boundaries: KGIS (Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre) district layer as mirrored at github.com/adarsh-dayanand/karnataka-geoJson (District.json; KGIS attributes with LGD codes, feature edits to Aug 2022), reprojected from UTM Zone 43N to WGS84 and simplified for web display; KGIS names 'Kalburgi', 'Kolara', 'Chamarajanagara', 'Chikkaballapura', 'Bengaluru (Urban)' and 'Bengaluru (Rural)' were mapped to the official district names used here. NFHS-5 (2019-20) covers the 30 pre-2021 districts; Ballari and Davanagere values are pre-split geography and Vijayanagara is null for survey/census indicators that predate its formation. District indicators are contextual outcomes only and are not attributable to any individual representative.
